fr_html: M. FERNANDES a rédigé un projet qui avait pour objet de fournir un terrain d'entente entre le Président et Mr. Root. Il se déclare heureux que l'accord soit déjà fait.
en_html: M. FERNANDES had prepared a plan the object of which was to furnish a basis of agreement between the President and Mr. Root. He was very glad that an agreement had already been reached.
